schema_description: Hook Configuration Schema - Define Pre and Post hooks for request/response processing

Client.description: The client or application name for which this hook configuration is defined

Hooks.description: Container for hook definitions organized by execution phase

Pre.description: Array of hooks that execute before the main request processing

Post.description: Array of hooks that execute after the main request processing completes

RequestName.description: Unique identifier for the hook, typically representing an API endpoint or action (e.g., '/Quote/Landing', '/Application/Summary')

NeedCascading.description: Indicates whether cascading operations should be applied; if true, the hook will cascade to related operations

HookCallCascading.description: Optional flag to control cascading behavior for hook calls; when true, enables cascading for nested hook executions

StaticParams.description: Configuration parameters specific to the hook execution

Actions.description: Array of action objects that define the operations to execute when this hook is triggered

FunctionName.description: The name of the function or handler to execute (e.g., 'GenerateQuoteNumber', 'EmailHook', 'ExecuteUnderWritingRules')

ModuleName.description: The module or package name where the function is defined (e.g., '@cogitate/core-pos-components', '@cogitate/base-homeowners-pos-components')

CallFunction.description: Flag indicating whether the function should be invoked; when true, the function will be called

isEndpoint.description: Flag indicating whether this action is an external endpoint call; when true, the action is treated as an HTTP/API endpoint invocation

Condition.description: Conditional expression that must evaluate to true for the action to execute (e.g., 'Transaction.Type = "Application"')

Path.description: File path or resource location for external script/configuration execution (e.g., 'BASE/configs/Personal/HO3/hooksCall/property.js')

Pre_Hooks.purpose: Execute validation, transformation, and preparation logic before request processing

Post_Hooks.purpose: Execute post-processing logic after request is handled, such as notifications and document handling
